item.description:
Madonna - Confessions II - The Film (YouTube Version) (Explicit) [M4A, AAC 256kbps 48kHz]

The album's accompanying musical film, Confessions II – The Film, built around the first six songs, was directed by TORSO (David Toro and Solomon Chase). It stars Madonna, with appearances by Arca, Archie Madekwe, Benedict Cumberbatch, Carpenter, Cole Palmer, Debi Mazar, Gwendoline Christie, Honey Dijon, Feid, João Pedro, Julia Garner, Kate Moss, Odessa A'zion, Richard E. Grant, Shygirl, and Lourdes Leon. The film premiered on June 5, 2026, at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, during the Tribeca Festival, followed by Madonna's conversation with Anderson Cooper filling in for the initially announced moderator Jimmy Fallon. It was released on YouTube on June 8, 2026.

Tracklist:
01 - Confessions... (01:17)
02 - Good For The Soul (01:17)
03 - One Step Away (01:52)
04 - Bring Your Love (feat. Sabrina Carpenter) (Lucky Star Mix) (01:47)
05 - Danceteria (01:31)
06 - Read My Lips (feat. Feid) (01:20)
07 - I Feel So Free (01:39)
08 - Bring Your Love (Stuart Price Afterhours Mix) (03:07)

Total length: 00:13:54

Note: Hey everyone! I know a few of you were a bit disappointed that the official film edition didn’t quite match the YouTube version. I felt the same way, so I decided to put this together for all of us. I extracted this directly from the original 1080p iTunes M4V file and transcoded it to ensure the best possible balance of video and audio quality. I really hope you enjoy watching this as much as I enjoyed putting it together!
